rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Sale Declaration of a Sponsor
rows.body: Mr. Tofazzal Hossain, a Sponsor of the Company, has expressed his intention to sell 7,00,000 shares out of his total holding of 1,49,43,225 shares of the company at prevailing market price (in the Public and Block Market) through Dhaka Stock Exchange PLC. (DSE) within October 31, 2024.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Sale Confirmation of a Sponsor
rows.body: Mr. Tofazzal Hossain, a Sponsor of the Company, has informed that he has completed his sale of 7,00,000 shares of the Company at prevailing market price through Dhaka Stock Exchange PLC. as per declaration disseminated on 23.09.2024.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Sale Declaration of a Sponsor
rows.body: Mr. Tofazzal Hossain, a Sponsor of the Company, has expressed his intention to sell 19,64,271 shares out of his total holding of 1,42,43,225 shares of the company at prevailing market price (in the Public and Block Market) through Dhaka Stock Exchange PLC. (DSE) within October 31, 2024.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Sale Confirmation of a Sponsor
rows.body: Mr. Tofazzal Hossain, a Sponsor of the Company, has informed that he has completed his sale of 19,64,271 shares of the Company at prevailing market price through Dhaka Stock Exchange PLC. as per declaration disseminated on 01.10.2024.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Board Meeting schedule under LR 16(1)
rows.body: As per Regulation 16(1) of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (Listing) Regulations, 2015, the Company has informed that a meeting of the Board of Directors will be held on October 30, 2024 at 3:00 PM to consider, among others, un-audited financial statements of the Company for the Third Quarter (Q3) period ended September 30, 2024.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Q3 Financials
rows.body: (Q3 Un-audited): Consolidated EPS was Tk. 1.06 for July-September 2024 as against Tk. 0.86 for July-September 2023; Consolidated EPS was Tk. 3.65 for January-September 2024 as against Tk. 3.31 for January-September 2023. Consolidated NOCFPS was Tk. 7.84 for January-September 2024 as against Tk. 11.92 for January-September 2023. Consolidated NAV per share was Tk. 23.30 as on September 30, 2024 and Tk. 21.60 as on September 30, 2023. (cont.)

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Q3 Financials
rows.body: (Continuation news of SHAHJABANK): EPS substantially increased compare to the same period of last year due to increase of Net Investment Income, Income from Commission, Exchange and Brokerage and Income from Investments in Shares & Securities. NOCFPS decreased compare to the same period of last year due to increase of Investment to customers and increase in other Assets. (end)

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Board Meeting schedule under LR 19(1)
rows.body: As per Regulation 19(1) of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (Listing) Regulations, 2015, the Company has informed that a meeting of the Board of Directors will be held on April 30, 2025 at 3:00 PM to consider, among others, audited financial statements of the Company for the year ended December 31, 2024.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Board Meeting schedule under LR 16(1)
rows.body: As per Regulation 16(1) of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (Listing) Regulations, 2015, the Company has informed that a meeting of the Board of Directors will be held on April 30, 2025 at 3:00 PM to consider, among others, un-audited financial statements of the Company for the First Quarter (Q1) period ended March 31, 2025.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Dividend Declaration
rows.body: (Continuation news of SHAHJABANK): Reasons for deviation: EPS substantially decreased compared to that of last year mainly due to the increase of provision for classified investments, provision for off-balance sheet items and provision for diminution in value of investments in shares. NOCFPS has decreased significantly compared to that of last year mainly due to the increase in investment to customers and increase of placement with other banks & financial institutions during the year. (end)

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Dividend Declaration
rows.body: The Board of Directors has recommended 10% Cash dividend for the year ended December 31, 2024. Date of AGM: 25.06.2025, Time: 11:00 AM, Venue: Digital Platform. Record date: 22.05.2025. The Company has also reported Consolidated EPS of Tk. 1.52, Consolidated NAV per share of Tk. 21.09 and Consolidated NOCFPS of Tk. 8.03 for the year ended December 31, 2024 as against Tk. 3.22, Tk. 21.38 and Tk. 10.09 respectively for the year ended December 31, 2023. (cont.)

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Price Limit Open
rows.body: There will be no price limit on the trading of the shares of the Company today (04.05.2025) following its corporate declaration.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Q1 Financials
rows.body: (Cont. news of SHAHJABANK): NOCFPS increased compared to the same period of last year due to increase of Investment income, lower increase of investment to customers and decreased of placement with other banks and financial institutions. (end)

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Q1 Financials
rows.body: (Q1 Un-audited): Consolidated EPS was Tk. 1.04 for January-March 2025 as against Tk. 1.09 for January-March 2024. Consolidated NOCFPS was Tk. 4.36 for January-March 2025 as against Tk. 1.43 for January-March 2024. Consolidated NAV per share was Tk. 22.02 as on March 31, 2025 and Tk. 22.36 as on March 31, 2024. Reasons for deviation in NOCFPS: (cont.)

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Spot News
rows.body: Trading of the shares of the company will be allowed only in the Spot Market and Block transaction will also be settled as per spot settlement cycle with cum benefit from 20.05.2025 to 21.05.2025 and trading of the shares will remain suspended on record date i.e., 22.05.2025.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Suspension for Record Date
rows.body: Trading of the shares of the company will remain suspended on record date i.e., 22.05.2025.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Credit Rating Result
rows.body: Emerging Credit Rating Limited (ECRL) has affirmed surveillance credit rating of the Company as "AA+" in the long term and "ST-2" in the short term along with a Stable outlook based on audited financial statements up to December 31, 2024 and other relevant quantitative as well as qualitative information up to the date of rating.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Resumption after record date
rows.body: Trading of the shares of the company will resume on 24.05.2025.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Decision to issue 4th Mudaraba Subordinated Bond
rows.body: The company has informed that the Board of Directors of the Bank in its meeting held on 28th May 2025 has decided to issue 7 (Seven) years Fully Redeemable, Unsecured, Non-Convertible, Floating Rate "SJIBPLC 4th Mudaraba Subordinated Bond" for BDT 6,000 Million (Six Thousand Million Taka) only to strengthen Tier-II capital of the Bank as per requirement under Basel III through private placement subject to the approval of the Regulatory Authorities and compliance of all formalities in this respect.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Board Meeting schedule under LR 16(1)
rows.body: As per Regulation 16(1) of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (Listing) Regulations, 2015, the Company has informed that a meeting of the Board of Directors will be held on July 30, 2025 at 4:00 PM to consider, among others, un-audited financial statements of the Company for the Second Quarter (Q2) period ended June 30, 2025.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Dividend Disbursement
rows.body: The Company has informed that it has disbursed the Cash Dividend for the year ended December 31, 2024 to the respective shareholders.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Q2 Financials
rows.body: (Cont. News of SHAHJABANK): Reasons for deviation: NOCFPS increased compared to the same period of last year due to increase of investment income and decrease of placement with other Banks and financial institution. (end)

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Q2 Financials
rows.body: (Q2 Un-audited): Consolidated EPS was Tk. 1.43 for April-June 2025 as against Tk. 1.50 for April-June 2024; Consolidated EPS was Tk. 2.47 for January-June 2025 as against Tk. 2.59 for January-June 2024. Consolidated NOCFPS was Tk. 15.39 for January-June 2025 as against Tk. 12.48 for January-June 2024. Consolidated NAV per share was Tk. 22.33 as on June 30, 2025 and Tk. 22.36 as on June 30, 2024. (cont.)

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Sell Intention
rows.body: Mr. Akkas Uddin Mollah, one of the Sponsors of the Company, has reported his intention to sell 2,10,25,364 shares out of his holding of 2,23,07,124 shares of the Company at prevailing market price (In the Block Market) through Chittagong Stock Exchange PLC (CSE) within next 30 working days.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Sell Confirmation
rows.body: Mr. Akkas Uddin Mollah, one of the Sponsors of the Company, has further informed that he has completed his sell of 2,10,25,364 shares of the Company at prevailing market price (In the Block Market) through Chittagong Stock Exchange PLC (CSE) as per declaration disseminated by CSE on 25.08.2025.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Declaration of share transfer by a Sponsor
rows.body: Mr. Abdul Halim, a Sponsor of the company, has expressed his intention to transfer 26,285,673 shares of the Company to his son Mr. Abdul Hakim (General Shareholder of the company), by way of gift outside the trading system of the Exchange within October 31, 2025.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Confirmation of share transfer by a Sponsor
rows.body: The company has informed that Mr. Abdul Halim, a Sponsor of the company, has transferred 26,285,673 shares of the Company to his son Mr. Abdul Hakim, by way of gift, outside the trading system of the Exchange as per declaration disseminated by DSE on 06.10.2025.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Transfer of shares outside the Trading System of the Exchange
rows.body: Dhaka Stock Exchange PLC. (DSE) has approved the transfer of 3,062,000 shares of Shahjalal Islami Bank PLC. of Mr. Anwer Hossain Khan, a Sponsor Director of the company, to LankaBangla Finance PLC. (the transferee) within next 30 working days with effect from October 12, 2025 other than by way of gift under Regulation 47 (1)(d) of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (Listing) Regulations, 2015 as well as other applicable laws.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Board Meeting schedule under LR 16(1)
rows.body: As per Regulation 16(1) of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (Listing) Regulations, 2015, the Company has informed that a meeting of the Board of Directors will be held on October 22, 2025 at 4:00 PM to consider, among others, Un-audited financial statements of the Company for the Third Quarter (Q3) period ended September 30, 2025.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Q3 Financials
rows.body: (Q3 Un-audited): Consolidated EPS was Tk. 1.02 for July-September, 2025 as against Tk. 1.06 for July-September, 2024; Consolidated EPS was Tk. 3.50 for January-September, 2025 as against Tk. 3.65 for January-September, 2024. Consolidated NOCFPS was Tk. 22.97 for January-September, 2025 as against Tk. 7.84 for January-September, 2024. Consolidated NAV per share was Tk. 23.39 as on September 30, 2025 and Tk. 23.30 as on September 30, 2024. (cont.)

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Q3 Financials
rows.body: (cont. news of SHAHJABANK): Reasons for deviation in NOCFPS: NOCFPS increased due to increase of investment income, increase of income from fees & commission and increase of placement from other banks and financial institutions. (end)

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Election of Chairman
rows.body: The company has informed that the Board of Directors has elected Mr. Mohammed Younus as the Chairman of the Company.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Board Meeting schedule under LR 19(1)
rows.body: As per Regulation 19(1) of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (Listing) Regulations, 2015, the Company has informed that a meeting of the Board of Directors will be held on April 08, 2026 at 3:00 PM to consider, among others, audited financial statements of the Company for the year ended December 31, 2025.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Dividend Declaration
rows.body: (Continuation news of SHAHJABANK): Operating Income & Earnings per Share substantially increased compared to that of last year mainly due to the increase of Net Investment Income, Income from Investments in Shares & Securities and Other Operating Income. NOCFPS has increased compared to that of last year mainly due to increase in investment income and increase of placement from other banks and financial institutions. (end)

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Transfer of shares outside the Trading System of the Exchange
rows.body: Dhaka Stock Exchange PLC. (DSE) has approved the transfer of 810,000 shares of Shahjalal Islami Bank PLC. held by Mr. Anwer Hossain Khan (Sponsor), transferor, to Bangladesh Finance PLC. (Institute), transferee, within next 30 working days outside the trading system of the Exchange other than by way of gift under Regulation 47(1)(d) of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (Listing) Regulations, 2015 as well as other applicable laws.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Dividend Declaration
rows.body: The Board of Directors has recommended 13% Cash Dividend for the year ended December 31, 2025. Date of AGM: 24.05.2026, Time: 11:00 a.m., Venue: Digital Platform. Record Date: 30.04.2026. The Company has also reported Consolidated EPS of Tk. 3.31, Consolidated NAV per share of Tk. 23.07 and Consolidated NOCFPS of Tk. 12.28 for the year ended December 31, 2025 as against Tk. 1.52, Tk. 21.09 and Tk. 8.03 respectively for the year ended December 31, 2024. (cont.)

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Price Limit Open
rows.body: There will be no price limit on the trading of the shares of the Company today (09.04.2026) following its corporate declaration.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Credit Rating Result
rows.body: Emerging Credit Rating Limited (ECRL) has affirmed surveillance credit rating of the Company as "AA+" in the long term and "ST-1" in the short term along with a Stable outlook based on audited financial statements up to December 31, 2025 and other relevant quantitative as well as qualitative information up to the date of rating.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Board Meeting schedule under LR 16(1)
rows.body: As per Regulation 16(1) of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (Listing) Regulations, 2015, the Company has informed that a meeting of the Board of Directors will be held on April 29, 2026 at 4:00 pm to consider, among others, Un-Audited Financial Statements for the First Quarter (Q1) period ended March 31, 2026.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Spot News
rows.body: Trading of the shares of the company will be allowed only in the Spot Market and Block transaction will also be settled as per spot settlement cycle with cum benefit from 28.04.2026 to 29.04.2026 and trading of the shares will remain suspended on record date i.e., 30.04.2026.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Suspension for Record Date
rows.body: Trading of the shares of the company will remain suspended on record date i.e. 30.04.2026.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Resumption after Record Date
rows.body: Trading of the shares of the company will resume on 03.05.2026.

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Q1 Financials
rows.body: (Cont. News of SHAHJABANK): Reasons for deviation: Net Operating Cash Flow per Share (NOCFPS) decreased compared to the same period of last year due to decrease in deposits received from customers and increase in profit paid on deposits and borrowings as a result of increase in cost of deposits. (end)

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Q1 Financials
rows.body: (Q1 Un-audited): Consolidated EPS was Tk. 1.12 for January-March 2026 as against Tk. 1.04 for January-March 2025. Consolidated NOCFPS was Tk. 3.07 for January-March 2026 as against Tk. 4.36 for January-March 2025. Consolidated NAV per share was Tk. 24.09 as on March 31, 2026 and Tk. 22.02 as on March 31, 2025. (cont.)

rows.title: SHAHJABANK: Emphasis of Matter
rows.body: The auditor of the company has given the Emphasis of Matter paragraph in the auditor's report for the year ended December 31, 2025. To view the details, please visit: https://www.dsebd.org/Auditors_opinion/2025/203.%20Shahjalal%20Islami%20Bank%20PLC2025.pdf
